sources.title: ChildVox - tiantiaf0627.github.io
sources.snippet: ChildVox is a unified benchmark covering the full developmental trajectory through which children "express" themselves, ranging from physiological sounds at birth, through infant vocalizations and toddler babble, to school-age speech.

sources.title: ChildVox: A Speech, Audio, and Large Audio-Language Model Benchmark in ...
sources.snippet: Benchmark results show that ChildVox provides a suite of high-performance models in recognizing a wide range of acoustic signals from children, supporting downstream applica-tions such as characterizing children's language levels and tracking speech production with age.

sources.title: ChildVox: A Speech, Audio, and Large Audio-Language Model Benchmark in ...
sources.snippet: For physiological sound classification tasks, SSAST and WavLM-Large generally outperform Whisper-family models or the voc2vec model. In particular, WavLM-Large achieves the highest performance on CirCor (0.643), while SSAST performs best on ICBHI-crackles, ICBHI-wheezes, and SPRSound.
